question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb6aca54b2f10154a07b88536a0a066558de9113b193e7a27019b57d6ef5da46.png]
solution:
Given,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb6aca54b2f10154a07b88536a0a066558de9113b193e7a27019b57d6ef5da46.png] 

In Figure 1st, 2nd and 3rd Dice 3 is common face in all the dices so, faces opposite to each other is shown below : 

The opposite faces are :

 
 

 3
 2
 1
 
 

 6
 4
 5
 
 

**2 **is the number on the face opposite to the face showing 4.

Hence,** "Option 2"** is the correct answer.
